purpose: Render compact public navigation with one-level nested branches and shared floating positioning.
accessibility: Expose nav, menubar, menuitem, aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, and current-page semantics.
Open branches with keyboard controls, focus the first item, and dismiss on Escape or outside interaction.
responsive: Keeps the link row horizontally usable on narrow public headers.
Positions branch panels in viewport space so parent containers do not clip them.
motion: Uses shared popup duration and easing.

api.name: items
api.description: Top-level links and one-level nested branches.

api.name: label
api.description: Accessible name for the public navigation.
